006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ArithmeticFunctionException;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.CastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.impl.OperationFunctions;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.TypeConstants;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017import java.math.BigDecimal;
018import java.math.BigInteger;
019import java.math.MathContext;
020import java.math.RoundingMode;
021
022import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
023
024/**
025 * Represents an atomic Metapath item containing a numeric data value, which can
026 * be either an integer or decimal. This interface provides operations for
027 * numeric type conversion, comparison, and mathematical operations commonly
028 * used in Metapath expressions.
029 *
030 * @see IIntegerItem
031 * @see IDecimalItem
032 */
033public interface INumericItem extends IAnyAtomicItem {
034  /**
035   * Get the type information for this item.
036   *
037   * @return the type information
038   */
039  @NonNull
040  static IAtomicOrUnionType<INumericItem> type() {
041    return TypeConstants.NUMERIC_TYPE;
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
046   * <p>
047   * Per XPath 3.1, boolean values are cast as: {@code true} → 1, {@code false} →
048   * 0.
049   *
050   * @param item
051   *          the item to cast
052   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
053   *         cast to this type
054   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
055   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
056   */
057  @NonNull
058  static INumericItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
059    INumericItem retval;
060    if (item instanceof INumericItem) {
061      retval = (INumericItem) item;
062    } else if (item instanceof IBooleanItem) {
063      // XPath 3.1: boolean true -> 1, false -> 0
064      retval = IIntegerItem.valueOf(((IBooleanItem) item).toBoolean());
065    } else {
066      try {
067        retval = IDecimalItem.valueOf(item.asString());
068      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
069        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
070        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
071      }
072    }
073    return retval;
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Get this item's value as a decimal.
078   *
079   * @return the equivalent decimal value
080   */
081  @NonNull
082  BigDecimal asDecimal();
083
084  /**
085   * Get this item's value as an integer.
086   *
087   * @return the equivalent integer value
088   */
089  @NonNull
090  BigInteger asInteger();
091
092  /**
093   * Convert this numeric item to a Java int, exactly. If the value is not in a
094   * valid int range, an exception is thrown.
095   *
096   * @return the int value
097   * @throws CastFunctionException
098   *           if the value does not fit in an int
099   */
100  int toIntValueExact();
101
102  /**
103   * Get the effective boolean value of this item based on
104   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-ebv">XPath 3.1</a>.
105   *
106   * @return the effective boolean value
107   */
108  boolean toEffectiveBoolean();
109
110  @Override
111  INumericItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item);
112
113  /**
114   * Get the absolute value of the item.
115   *
116   * @return this item negated if this item is negative, or the item otherwise
117   */
118  @NonNull
119  INumericItem abs();
120
121  /**
122   * Round the value to the whole number closest to positive infinity.
123   *
124   * @return the rounded value
125   */
126  @NonNull
127  IIntegerItem ceiling();
128
129  /**
130   * Round the value to the whole number closest to negative infinity.
131   *
132   * @return the rounded value
133   */
134  @NonNull
135  IIntegerItem floor();
136
137  /**
138   * Round the item's value with zero precision.
139   * <p>
140   * This is the same as calling {@link #round(IIntegerItem)} with a precision of
141   * {@code 0}.
142   *
143   * @return the rounded value
144   */
145  @NonNull
146  default INumericItem round() {
147    return round(IIntegerItem.ZERO);
148  }
149
150  /**
151   * Round the item's value with the specified precision.
152   * <p>
153   * This is the same as calling {@link #round(IIntegerItem)} with a precision of
154   * {@code 0}.
155   *
156   * @param precisionItem
157   *          the precision indicating the number of digits to round to before
158   *          (negative value} or after (positive value) the decimal point.
159   * @return the rounded value
160   */
161  @NonNull
162  default INumericItem round(@NonNull IIntegerItem precisionItem) {
163    int precision;
164    try {
165      precision = precisionItem.toIntValueExact();
166    } catch (CastFunctionException ex) {
167      throw new ArithmeticFunctionException(ArithmeticFunctionException.OVERFLOW_UNDERFLOW_ERROR,
168          "Numeric operation overflow/underflow.", ex);
169    }
170    return precision >= 0
171        ? roundWithPositivePrecision(precision)
172        : roundWithNegativePrecision(precision);
173  }
174
175  @NonNull
176  private INumericItem roundWithPositivePrecision(int precision) {
177    INumericItem retval;
178    if (this instanceof IIntegerItem) {
179      retval = this;
180    } else {
181      BigDecimal value = asDecimal();
182      BigDecimal rounded = value.signum() == -1
183          ? value.round(new MathContext(precision + value.precision() - value.scale(), RoundingMode.HALF_DOWN))
184          : value.round(new MathContext(precision + value.precision() - value.scale(), RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
185      retval = castAsType(IDecimalItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(rounded)));
186    }
187    return retval;
188  }
189
190  /**
191   * Rounds a number to the specified negative precision by: 1. Computing the
192   * divisor (10^|precision|) 2. If the absolute value is less than the divisor,
193   * returns 0 3. Otherwise, rounds to the nearest multiple of the divisor
194   *
195   * @param precision
196   *          the negative precision to round to
197   * @return the rounded value
198   */
199  @NonNull
200  private INumericItem roundWithNegativePrecision(int precision) {
201    BigInteger value = asInteger();
202    BigInteger divisor = BigInteger.TEN.pow(0 - precision);
203
204    INumericItem retval;
205    if (divisor.compareTo(value.abs()) > 0) {
206      retval = IIntegerItem.ZERO;
207    } else {
208      BigInteger remainder = value.mod(divisor);
209      BigInteger lessRemainder = value.subtract(remainder);
210      BigInteger halfDivisor = divisor.divide(BigInteger.TWO);
211      BigInteger roundedValue = remainder.compareTo(halfDivisor) >= 0
212          ? lessRemainder.add(divisor)
213          : lessRemainder;
214      retval = IIntegerItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(roundedValue));
215    }
216    return retval;
217  }
218
219  /**
220   * Create a new sum by adding this value to the provided addend value.
221   *
222   * @param addend
223   *          the second value to sum
224   * @return a new value resulting from adding this value to the provided addend
225   *         value
226   */
227  @NonNull
228  default INumericItem add(@NonNull INumericItem addend) {
229    return OperationFunctions.opNumericAdd(this, addend);
230  }
231
232  /**
233   * Determine the difference by subtracting the provided subtrahend value from
234   * this minuend value.
235   *
236   * @param subtrahend
237   *          the value to subtract
238   * @return a new value resulting from subtracting the subtrahend from the
239   *         minuend
240   */
241  @NonNull
242  default INumericItem subtract(@NonNull INumericItem subtrahend) {
243    return OperationFunctions.opNumericSubtract(this, subtrahend);
244  }
245
246  /**
247   * Multiply this multiplicand value by the provided multiplier value.
248   *
249   * @param multiplier
250   *          the value to multiply by
251   * @return a new value resulting from multiplying the multiplicand by the
252   *         multiplier
253   */
254  @NonNull
255  default INumericItem multiply(@NonNull INumericItem multiplier) {
256    return OperationFunctions.opNumericMultiply(this, multiplier);
257  }
258
259  /**
260   * Divide this dividend value by the provided divisor value.
261   *
262   * @param divisor
263   *          the value to divide by
264   * @return a new value resulting from dividing the dividend by the divisor
265   */
266  @NonNull
267  default INumericItem divide(@NonNull INumericItem divisor) {
268    return OperationFunctions.opNumericDivide(this, divisor);
269  }
270
271  /**
272   * Divide this dividend value by the provided divisor value using integer
273   * division.
274   *
275   * @param divisor
276   *          the value to divide by
277   * @return a new value resulting from dividing the dividend by the divisor
278   */
279  @NonNull
280  default IIntegerItem integerDivide(@NonNull INumericItem divisor) {
281    return OperationFunctions.opNumericIntegerDivide(this, divisor);
282  }
283
284  /**
285   * Compute the remainder when dividing this dividend value by the provided
286   * divisor value.
287   *
288   * @param divisor
289   *          the value to divide by
290   * @return a new value containing the remainder resulting from dividing the
291   *         dividend by the divisor
292   */
293  @NonNull
294  default INumericItem mod(@NonNull INumericItem divisor) {
295    return OperationFunctions.opNumericMod(this, divisor);
296  }
297
298  /**
299   * Reverse the sign of this value.
300   *
301   * @return a new value with the sign reversed
302   */
303  @NonNull
304  INumericItem negate();
305}
